description: Checks up to 10 domains against the registry in real time (RDAP) and reports whether each is registered right now. For confirming availability just before a recommendation or purchase decision, and for any name an earlier answer marked 'unknown', 'pending' or 'unprobed', which are never registration claims. It answers whether a registration exists, not whether the name can be bought or at what price: reserved and premium names also read as unregistered here. It does not judge whether a name is good, and it does not fetch the site, so it reports 'registered' rather than 'active' or 'dormant'. Read-only. Cannot spend money.
name: check_live

results.description: One row per domain asked about, with its verdict and evidence grade.
